master_sayings.phrase: Building got cheap; reach and demand did not.
master_sayings.creator: Steve | Systems & AI (@sd141414)
master_sayings.strategic_hook: When synthetic code costs zero, code volume is a liability. Value shifts to demand proximity and systems taste.

master_sayings.creator: Kyler Cheatham (@kylercheatham)
master_sayings.strategic_hook: Never automate dysfunction. If departments are siloed on paper, a $2M ERP migration simply automates the friction.

master_sayings.phrase: One folder second brain: instructions over frameworks.
master_sayings.creator: Jake Van Clief (@jakevanclief)
master_sayings.strategic_hook: Agents are just a naming convention. A clean CLAUDE.md and repeatable folder boundaries beat over-engineered framework theater.

master_sayings.phrase: Vendor green is not business green.
master_sayings.creator: Eric Kimberling (@erickimberling0)
master_sayings.strategic_hook: The SI's milestone dashboard turns green when the software is installed. The business dashboard stays red until plant-floor cutover works.

master_sayings.phrase: Enterprise AI is a people & process problem, not a tech problem.
master_sayings.creator: Jenna Gardner (@jenna_gardner_ai)
master_sayings.strategic_hook: Buying more frontier model licenses causes swirl. Production transformation requires process redesign and centralized operational knowledge.

master_sayings.phrase: Enterprise buyers don't ask to see your code; they ask about data flows, access, and logging.
master_sayings.creator: Steve | Systems & AI (@sd141414)
master_sayings.strategic_hook: Enterprise sales aren't won on prompt magic. CFOs and CIOs buy deterministic auditability, reversibility, and access controls.

master_sayings.creator: Kyler Cheatham (@kylercheatham)
master_sayings.strategic_hook: Token burn without deterministic caller gates creates five-figure cloud surprises. Architecture must enforce strict spend ceilings.

master_sayings.creator: Eric Kimberling (@erickimberling0)
master_sayings.strategic_hook: Systems integrators leave when cutover lights go green. We transfer ownership through the adoption valley where 70% of ERPs fail.

master_sayings.phrase: There is no going back from AI-written code without decision records.
master_sayings.creator: Steve | Systems & AI (@sd141414)
master_sayings.strategic_hook: AI code is a one-way door. Test harnesses and architectural decision records preserve reversibility when models hallucinate.

master_sayings.phrase: Prompt guardrails are not infrastructure security.
master_sayings.creator: Liv | AI Product Manager (@livs.playbook)
master_sayings.strategic_hook: System prompts cannot stop SQL injection or unauthorized API mutations. Security lives in containerized execution gates.

master_sayings.phrase: Autonomous digital PR: results over pitch blasts.
master_sayings.creator: Kayla Mae Fargo (@kaylamaefargo)
master_sayings.strategic_hook: Spamming journalists with LLM copy burns domain reputation. High-signal outbound matches hyper-targeted editorial beats.

master_sayings.phrase: Anti-AI aesthetic tokens beat corporate prompt slop.
master_sayings.creator: Thomas Schlossmacher (@sourcetms)
master_sayings.strategic_hook: Generic LLM copy and bootstrap UI scream amateur. High-altitude enterprises require Swiss minimalist design tokens and structured JSON DNA.
